White House Officials Seize Reporters' Phones on Air Force One

White House officials collected the mobile phones of journalists traveling with US President Donald Trump aboard Air Force One shortly after the aircraft departed China on Thursday. The officials cited security concerns for the seizure, leaving reporters without their devices as the presidential plane began its journey.
